meta_title: Pickles Michael | Tree Surgery & Arborist Leeds
meta_description: Pickles Michael is a trusted arborist in Leeds offering professional tree surgery, felling, and maintenance. Expert care for your trees. Call today.
hero_subhead: Safe tree felling, pruning, and stump removal across Leeds. We handle hazardous trees with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services in Leeds
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency felling, we deliver safe and professional arboricultural work for homes and businesses.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We manage the entire process—from careful felling to stump grinding and waste clearance—minimising disruption to your property.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Professional crown thinning and reduction to improve tree health, restore shape, and reduce wind resistance. Cuts made to arboricultural standards.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Hazardous dead branches removed to prevent accidents and disease spread. Improves the safety and appearance of your trees immediately.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Complete stump removal using specialist grinding equipment. Leaves your garden level and ready for replanting or landscaping.

services.title: Emergency Tree Work
services.desc: Storm damage, hanging branches, or dangerous trees? We respond quickly to make your property safe and prevent further damage.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Management
services.desc: Neat, healthy hedges maintained to your preferred height. Regular cutting promotes growth and keeps boundaries looking tidy year-round.

about_pullquote: Trees deserve respect. We treat every job like it's our own garden.
about_para_1: Pickles Michael has been caring for trees and gardens across Leeds for nearly two decades. What began as a passion for arboriculture has grown into a trusted local business, backed by years of hands-on experience and a genuine commitment to doing the job right—safely and professionally every time.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen. Whether you're concerned about a hazardous branch, planning new landscaping, or dealing with storm damage, we assess your trees honestly and recommend only the work they actually need. We take pride in leaving your garden tidier than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Our Tree Work

reviews.text: Michael came out to assess a massive oak that was threatening to damage the fence. He explained exactly what needed doing and the cost was fair. The work was done brilliantly—ground was left spotless, no mess left behind. Couldn't ask for better. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a dead willow hanging over the garage after a storm. Michael arrived next morning and had it down, chipped, and cleared within a few hours. Professional, quick, and he even swept up afterwards. Great bloke.
reviews.author: Rebecca M.

reviews.text: Three large conifers needed removing before we could extend. Got quotes from others but Michael's price was honest and his work was immaculate. Stumps ground out completely. Would use again without hesitation.
reviews.author: James H.
